verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents exporting a whole docs site as a static bundle that can be hosted anywhere. Per-page `.md` export, the local CLI preview, custom domains, and running Mintlify itself in your own cloud or Kubernetes (self-host) are related features, but none is a static-site export, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can export my entire docs site as a static bundle and host it anywhere, so my content is never locked in
